info.title: Deadlines to file an employment-discrimination charge: the federal EEOC limit and each state agency's own limit: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Deadlines to file an employment-discrimination charge: the federal EEOC limit and each state agency's own limit: How long a worker has to file a charge of employment discrimination: the EEOC's 180-day limit and its 300-day extension, and the limit each covered state's own statute sets for its civil-rights agency. One row per rule, with the statute citation, the official document's URL and the verbatim quote (25 words or fewer) that carries the number.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
